integrity: The counterexample is analytic and uses the standard Gaussian kernel admitted by the source. No finite experiment is used as proof; the asymptotics follow from exact KRR normal equations, Gaussian separation bounds, and an exact two-step resolved update.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the stated hypothesis/proof interface of Theorem 2.1 and a natural teacher-forced repair. It does not refute the theorem if assumption (8) is redefined to bound the actual coupled unresolved rollout directly, and it does not assert failure of the paper's empirical rollout-aware validation.
title: True-orbit KRR accuracy does not control coupled closure rollout
